featured_reviews.name: Devika Cheulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Yoga Institute is not just a place to learn yoga it is a place where yoga is lived. Rooted deeply in tradition, this institute offers an authentic and classical understanding of yoga that goes far beyond physical practice. It’s aligned with true Indian philosophy, preserving the true essence of yoga in a world where it is often diluted.

On a practical level, the training is structured, disciplined, and thorough. From asana alignment and anatomy to pranayama, meditation, philosophy, and teaching methodology, every subject is taught with clarity and precision. The faculty is knowledgeable, experienced, and genuinely invested in shaping confident, responsible yoga teachers.

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Stars: Transformative Year at The Yoga Institute.

I joined seeking a deeper understanding of the synchronization between the Law of the Universe, the laws governing our mind, body, and consciousness, and how they interplay with modern society's laws.
I discovered a beautiful, harmonious relationship among all three.
The comprehensive syllabus—spanning Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, Hatha Yoga, Bhagavad Gita, and Samkhya philosophy—brought this to life.
The teachers are true yogis, with Dr. Hansa ji, one of the greatest yoginis, sharing profound wisdom from ancient yogic sciences through her masterful guidance on sutra applications, pranayama techniques, and holistic living. Asana practice revealed the psychosomatic truth: "as the mind, so the body; as the body, so the mind," synchronizing my entire being.
Now, yoga is my way of life.Unparalleled for authentic self-discovery. Grateful beyond words!.... Namaskar 🙏

I also run an Instagram page with over 400k followers focused mainly on bodybuilding content, so having a private area for posing is important for me. This change was never communicated to anyone.
